title: Recorded Lecture Link Saver App

requirements.text: Create a backend data model and API to store recorded lecture links. Each entry should have: a title, a URL (the lecture recording link), an optional description/notes field, a label/category tag, and a creation timestamp.

quotes: Record lecture ka link ha Mera pass or usko mera ko alag say save karna ha drive may lika yad rakhna

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes functions to add, retrieve, update, and delete lecture link entries.
Each lecture entry stores: title, URL, notes, label, and createdAt timestamp.
Data persists across canister upgrades using stable storage.

requirements.text: Build a frontend page that allows users to save a new recorded lecture link by entering a title, the video URL, an optional notes/description, and an optional label/category. Display a confirmation after saving.

quotes: usko mera ko alag say save karna ha
wo lecture ka link ha record video is link ka under may ha

acceptanceCriteria: A form is available with fields: Title (required), URL (required), Notes (optional), Label/Category (optional).
Submitting the form saves the entry to the backend.
A success message is shown after a link is saved.
URL field validates that the input is a valid URL format.

requirements.text: Build a frontend drive-style list view that displays all saved lecture links. Each entry should show the title, label/category badge, notes snippet, creation date, and a clickable button to open the video URL in a new tab.

quotes: wo lecture ka link ha record video is link ka under may ha

acceptanceCriteria: All saved lecture entries are displayed in a list/card layout.
Each card shows: title, label badge, notes preview, date saved, and an 'Open Video' button.
Clicking 'Open Video' opens the link in a new browser tab.
The list updates immediately after a new entry is saved.

requirements.text: Add search and filter functionality to the lecture list so users can search by title or notes keyword, and filter by label/category.
acceptanceCriteria: A search bar filters displayed entries by title or notes content in real time.
A label/category filter dropdown narrows results to the selected tag.
Clearing the search/filter restores the full list.

requirements.text: Allow users to delete a saved lecture link entry from the list view.
acceptanceCriteria: A delete button is present on each lecture entry card.
Clicking delete removes the entry from the backend and the UI updates immediately.
A confirmation prompt is shown before deletion.

requirements.text: Apply a clean, modern notebook/drive-inspired visual theme — warm neutral tones (cream, amber, slate), clear card-based layout, readable typography, and subtle folder/bookmark iconography — consistently across all pages and components.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages use a consistent warm neutral color palette.
Cards have clean borders, subtle shadows, and clear typographic hierarchy.
Label badges use distinct accent colors for visual differentiation.
The UI feels organized and drive/notebook-like throughout.

constraints: All lecture data must be stored on-chain in the Motoko backend using stable storage.
Do not integrate any external drive or cloud storage services.
nonGoals: Video playback inside the app — links open externally.

required: Flat illustration of a bookmarked notebook with a play button on the cover, warm amber and cream tones (lecture-vault-logo.dim_256x256.png)
